2: # dot
3: 
4:   Get and set object properties with dot notation
5: 
6: ## Installation
7: 
8:     $ component install eivindfjeldstad/dot
9: 
10: ## API
11: 
12: ### dot.set(object, path, value)
13: ```js
14:   dot.set(obj, 'cool.aid', 'rocks');
15:   assert(obj.cool.aid === 'rocks');
16: ```
17: 
18: ### dot.get(object, path)
19: ```js
20: var value = dot.get(obj, 'cool.aid');
21: assert(value === 'rocks');
22: ```
23:
